established_findings.finding: No620-jet or62000-jet training restriction is present in the audited pilot. Frozen cache reports558000 training rows; make_epoch_step traverses all rows every epoch after a full permutation. Calibration and tracing sample settings do not cap optimizer training rows.

Recorded cache is balanced across five classes, correctly sorted at topN, and has zero all-gated jets. pT>=2 gate removes constituent slots, not jets. There is no positive evidence here of class permutation, absent training classes, or tiny training-pool coverage. This is not a fresh raw-data or current prediction-array audit.

Eight current pilot-B arms completed500 epochs. The declared Chang reference schedule is7000 epochs with500-epoch LR restarts. No completed7000-epoch binary confirmation exists in the audited artifacts. Longer training might change trajectories, but completion alone has not been demonstrated to repair compression collapse.

A-s1 initially learns discrimination but both training and validation accuracies later approachchance as cost and aggregate activation widths shrink. The existing recorded zero-based epochs4,299,499 give valaccuracy .652209677,.237564516,.201919355 and trainaccuracy .629146993,.238281369,.202878147. At epoch499 taskloss1.617011070 and total loss3.326268911 are recorded. This supports compression-associated representational failure, not ordinary overfitting. It does not isolate the responsible controller gain, layer, or binary mechanism.

The NRP A26 readouts for350k-target selected/fallback A,D,F,E1 and A07 show exactly uniform attention and zero-width query paths. A/A-s2/E1 selected paths also have zero-width values. Attention is ineffective at these checkpoints. Attention collapse alone is insufficient to explain near-chance tagging: the paper reports its collapsed N64 MHA at77.9%. Global compression and loss deterioration must also be investigated.
established_findings.confidence: NRP source-quoted diagnostics, single selected checkpoint per arm

established_findings.finding: Recorded synthetic CPU floors: A07 zero floor343053 at target350000 leaves6947; its minimal input/Wk/QK path costs8192. Under the present architecture, quantizers and cost model, feasible A07 cannot carry data-dependent attention. The smaller A/E floor171526 leaves178474, so this impossibility does not extend to all smaller binary models. Its fully alive1-bit attention-stream floor368134 also exceeds350000, so partial pruning is necessary; this is not proof that all partial attention is impossible.
established_findings.confidence: engineering floor analysis; not tagging result

established_findings.finding: Current A uses binary fixed-sign kernels, d24,2heads, head dimension12, no normalization, linear input projection, one24-unit classifier hidden layer. Released xfm uses learned per-weight HGQ precision/pruning, d24,2heads with head dimension16, input BN/ReLU, pre-attention and pre-FFN tanh LUTs, quantized residual adds and three32-unit BN/ReLU classifier hidden layers. Matching LR and batch does not reproduce that model. These changes are confounded, so their individual accuracy penalties are unknown.

Historical regime-B PID switches between full-training traced cost on traced epochs and fresh last-minibatch training cost on the other epochs. Cost is not held between traces. This is a known comparability issue; K1 remains triggered. Recorded user option(c) directs preparation of a traced-cost remedy, but remedy review/freeze/replacement-pilot validation and production clearance remain pending. Controller bias cannot alone be asserted to explain near-chance under-budget accuracy.

Released Chang code uses open-loop beta scheduling starting2e-8 and ramping over7000epochs; current pilot starts PIDbeta1e-7 with one-epochwarmup and aggressively pursues350k. Paper saysPID but publishes no gains. Present controller is not a reproduction of released beta schedule or documented paper gains. Early total/task losses show resource penalty is already substantial. A gentler or delayed compression schedule is a hypothesis requiring a separate registered intervention.

NRP snapshot certification for selected A-s2 and D primary/AUC-sensitivity checkpoints found exact agreement among logged, stored and558000-row retraced cost. This rules out a stale cost display for those checkpoints; it does not establish training-controller comparability or full review clearance.

Frozen CPU build counts distinguish coefficient count from all Keras variables: A/D6253 coefficients and31735 total; A07/C11653 and61951; E1(onehead)6253 and19447; Cprime11653 and12788. The19000 target is not documented in the paper. eBOP values in millions are operation/bit costs, not millions of learned coefficients.
